name: Tale of the Court's Daughter and the Beast
source:
The court people know this as a tale of tragedy; their beloved and revered Daughter died in the hand of a savage they called the Beast. But is that really all there is to the story?

[From [url=https://sbhunter.itch.io/courts-daughter-and-the-beast]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
宫廷人士都知道这是一个悲剧故事。他们深爱和尊敬的女儿死于他们称为野兽的野蛮人手中。但这真的是故事的全部吗？

[来自[url=https://sbhunter.itch.io/courts-daughter-and-the-beast]itch.io[/url]]
